answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The sparrow cap is upheld at intake and voyage makes public the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a bridge tag. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
